component.name: Ocean Terminal
component.summary: Clean, lightweight GPU-accelerated terminal emulator with full Myanmar/Burmese support

description.p: Ocean is a clean, minimal, ultra-lightweight GPU-accelerated terminal emulator written in Rust with full Myanmar / Burmese OpenType (mym2 / mymr) shaping support, Wayland and X11 IME preedit, keyboard-first split panes, a Neovim-style status bar, and Ghostty-compatible configuration.
